entry.title: Virtual Dietitian
entry.lead: An automated assistant that asks about your goals and constraints, then suggests a starting point you can accept, change or hand to a qualified dietitian.
entry.isOne: A structured interview that collects your goal, your activity, your restrictions, your budget and your delivery area.
entry.isTwo: A suggested calorie and macronutrient starting point, with the arithmetic and the assumptions shown.
entry.isThree: A draft week you can send to a registered dietitian for review before you follow any of it.
entry.isNotOne: It is not a clinician. It does not diagnose, treat or prescribe anything.
entry.isNotTwo: It is not a substitute for care from a qualified dietitian or doctor, and nothing it says should replace their advice.
entry.isNotThree: It is not a language model. Every reply in this prototype is a fixed, written script and no suggestion leaves your device unreviewed.
entry.startBody: A new session begins with the interview. Nothing is saved to a plan and nothing is ordered until you ask for it.
entry.startFailed: The session could not be started. Nothing was changed.
entry.sessionsEmptyBody: Start one above. You can leave a session at any point and come back to it.

aiNotice.title: Everything suggested here is machine-generated
aiNotice.body: Suggestions carry an "AI-generated suggestion" label wherever they appear. Anything a person set carries a different label. The two are never shown the same way.

initial_interview.activity: I train three times a week, so moderately active.
initial_interview.goal: I would like to lose weight steadily, not quickly.

analysing.confirmRestrictions: Yes — treat the allergy, the intolerance and both limits as fixed.

suggested_targets.looksRight: Those figures look reasonable to me.
suggested_targets.moreProtein: I would prefer a little more protein than that.

suggested_meal_structure.confirmLayout: Three meals and one snack works for me.
suggested_meal_structure.kitchenLunch: Lunch from a kitchen, the rest prepared at home.

restriction_conflict.relaxSoy: Soy is fine — I only wanted to avoid tree nuts.
restriction_conflict.allowHome: I can prepare more meals at home if that helps.

no_suitable_meals.widenArea: Dubai Marina works for delivery as well.
no_suitable_meals.allowHome: Home-prepared meals are fine for most of the week.

collected.title: What you have told the assistant
collected.empty: Nothing collected yet. Your answers appear here as you give them.

interview.title: The interview
interview.body: Answer in your own words, or pick a suggestion. Anything you give can be changed later.
interview.askingTitle: What the assistant still wants to know
interview.askOne: Your age, height and weight, so a published equation can be used.
interview.askTwo: How active you usually are in a normal week.
interview.askThree: What you are aiming for, and how quickly.

analysing.title: What is being considered
analysing.considerOne: Your stated activity level, goal and pace.
analysing.considerTwo: Every restriction on your profile, including the ones a dietitian set.
analysing.considerThree: The meal times you gave and the cooking time you have on a weekday.
analysing.considerFour: Which kitchens deliver to your area, and what they publish.
analysing.note: No language model is involved. This step reads your answers against fixed rules.

missing.title: What is missing
missing.body: Each of these can be answered in the reply box. The required ones block a suggestion; the optional ones only narrow it.
missing.jumpHint: Puts the question in the reply box below

targets.title: Suggested targets
targets.prototypeNote: Produced by the prototype calculator from published equations. It is an estimate, not a prescription.
targets.acknowledge: I have read the disclaimer above and understand these figures are an estimate.
targets.acknowledgeRequired: Tick the acknowledgement to accept these figures.
targets.acceptFailed: The acceptance could not be recorded. Nothing was changed.
targets.decline: Have a dietitian set these instead
targets.declineHint: Sends the session to a qualified dietitian rather than accepting the suggestion.

structure.title: Suggested meal structure
structure.kitchensHint: Only kitchens that sell through the marketplace are listed. Leave it empty to consider all of them.
structure.kitchensEmpty: No marketplace kitchens are available to choose from.
structure.budgetHint: A ceiling for the week, not a promise to spend it.
structure.areaHint: Used to rule out kitchens that cannot reach you.
structure.generateHint: Writes a draft plan. Nothing is ordered and nothing is locked.
structure.generateFailed: The draft could not be generated. Nothing was changed.

draft.title: Draft week
draft.body: A draft week has been written from the targets and the meal structure above. Nothing in it is locked, and nothing has been ordered.
draft.mixValue: {{kitchen}} from a kitchen, {{home}} prepared at home
draft.openInPlannerMessage: The planner can only show your active plan today. Opening this draft there needs plan-addressable planner routes (GET /api/v1/meal-plans/{plan}). Nothing was changed.
draft.requestReview: Ask a dietitian to review it
draft.requestFailed: The review request could not be sent. Nothing was changed.
draft.reviewHint: A registered dietitian checks the plan before you follow it. You can keep using the draft in the meantime.

review.title: With a dietitian
review.body: This plan has been sent to a qualified dietitian. Nothing changes while it waits, and you can keep using the draft.
review.queueBody: This prototype does not model a queue position for the person waiting. No proposed endpoint publishes one; the dietitian-side queue is GET /api/v1/professional/review-queue.
review.checkOne: That the energy and protein figures suit what you described, and are safe for you.
review.checkTwo: That every declared allergy and enforced restriction is honoured across the whole week.
review.checkThree: That the meals are varied enough to be followed for more than a few days.
review.checkFour: Anything you asked about in the conversation.

approved.title: Approved by a dietitian
approved.body: A qualified dietitian has reviewed this plan and signed it off. Their name is recorded against the review.
approved.approverUnknown: The reviewing dietitian is not recorded on this session.
approved.approverSynthetic: This professional and their registration are synthetic prototype data.
approved.changedNone: Nothing was overridden. The dietitian approved the figures as suggested.

failed.title: The week could not be built
failed.body: This is a fault on our side, not something you did. Nothing was changed, your answers are intact, and you can try again.
failed.alternativeBody: Ask a qualified dietitian to look at the session instead. They can build the week by hand.

conflict.title: Restrictions conflict
conflict.body: Two of your restrictions cannot both be satisfied at this energy target. The assistant has stopped rather than quietly dropping one of them.
conflict.requiresProfessional: Only a dietitian can resolve this
conflict.adjustBody: Relax something that is a preference rather than a medical restriction, and the assistant will try again.
conflict.reviewBody: A registered dietitian can decide which restriction gives way. An automated assistant must not.

noMeals.title: Nothing available fits
noMeals.body: No meals from kitchens that deliver to your area fit these restrictions this week.
noMeals.whyOne: Your delivery area is served by few kitchens, and those kitchens publish few matching meals.
noMeals.whyTwo: The restrictions in force exclude most of what is available.
noMeals.whyThree: Kitchen-prepared only leaves nothing to fall back on.
noMeals.widenOne: Widen the delivery area to include a neighbouring one.
noMeals.widenTwo: Allow home-prepared meals for part of the week.
noMeals.widenThree: Raise the weekly budget ceiling if it is currently tight.

safety.title: This conversation has stopped
safety.body: What you have described needs a person, not an automated assistant. No further suggestions will be made in this session, and nothing here has been generated in response to it.
safety.contactBody: Please speak to your doctor or a qualified dietitian. If you are in immediate danger, contact your local emergency service.
safety.contactPlaceholder: This prototype carries no real helpline numbers. A production build would show the services for your country here, verified before release.
safety.noActions: Generation, drafting and review actions are deliberately unavailable on this screen.

allergenReminder.title: Check the allergen list on every meal
allergenReminder.body: Declared allergens are excluded from everything suggested here, but a kitchen can change a recipe. Read the allergen list on any meal before you eat it, including ones you have eaten before.

override.dialogDescription: This replaces the suggested figures with your own. The suggestion is kept and stays labelled as machine-generated.
override.consequencesTitle: What happens if you do this
override.consequencesBody: Your figures are recorded as set by you, not by the assistant, and no professional has checked them. Meals will be planned against your figures instead. You can still ask a dietitian to review the session afterwards.
override.reasonHint: Recorded on the session so a dietitian can see what you intended.
override.reasonRequired: Give a reason so the change is not anonymous.
override.energyHint: The macronutrient split from the suggestion is kept and rescaled to this figure.
override.energyInvalid: Enter a daily energy figure between 800 and 6000 kcal.
override.failed: The override could not be applied. Nothing was changed.
override.appliedBody: These figures were set by a person, not by the assistant.

timeline.title: What has happened in this session
timeline.overridden: The proposal was overridden by a person
